annotations.title: Get runnable R, Python, or Julia code

description: Get runnable code from the library for a specific statistical, econometric, causal inference, or machine learning task, in R, Python, or Julia. Suited to requests for code that carries out a named estimator, test, or modeling step; it returns code with brief context, not an explanation of the method. Results can be restricted to one language or one work. Returns code blocks with the section they come from, the packages they use, a link, and a citation.

language.description: Programming language of the code: r, python, or julia.

limit.description: Number of sections to return code from (default 4).

source.description: Limit to one work: data_analysis (A Guide on Data Analysis); causalverse (causalverse: The All-in-One Causal Inference Toolkit); credit_score (Credit Scoring: Theory, Methods, and Practice); marketing_research (Marketing Research: A Technical and Academic Treatment); ai_in_action (AI in Action: A Reference for Artificial Intelligence); advanced_data_analysis (Advanced Data Analysis); tidy_finance_vn (Applying Tidy Finance with Python to Vietnam); tidy_finance_vn_vi (Tài Chính Ứng Dụng với Python); mlpy (Machine Learning in Python); social_theory (Social Science Theory: A Field Guide to the Theories, Effects, and Frameworks Behind Research and Business); publications (Research Articles and Publications).

topic.description: The task, e.g. "Callaway and Sant'Anna group-time ATT", "rdrobust bandwidth", "WoE binning scorecard".

name: get_code
title: Get runnable R, Python, or Julia code
